purpose: Targeted source-only remediation after v0.8 reassurance run 36560923261 found that BUS-PEO-010 paternalistic leadership was educationally sound but lacked direct promotion-eligible reusable source support.

source_additions.title: Exploring the Relationship Between Paternalistic Leadership, Teacher Commitment, and Job Satisfaction in Chinese Schools
source_additions.date_version: Published 2020-07-08; current CC BY page checked 2026-09-29
source_additions.educational_role: Direct reusable support for paternalistic leadership as a multidimensional leadership construct combining retained authority with benevolence/welfare concern and moral leadership, including reciprocal subordinate obligation and evidence that authoritarian and benevolent/moral dimensions can have different effects.
source_additions.restrictions: Use the stable leadership construct and mechanisms only. Do not universalise China/school-specific empirical findings or imply that paternalistic leadership is uniformly effective across cultures, organisations or decisions. Preserve the distinction between benevolent concern and participative transfer of decision authority.
